title: Ijen Geopark Run 2026 Review: What the First Edition Was Like
seo_title: Ijen Geopark Run 2026 Review | Banyuwangi, East Java
meta_description: Ijen Geopark Run 2026 review: 839 runners from Paltuding on Mount Ijen on 23 August, cool mountain air, and what runners said about the route.
dek: The first Ijen Geopark Run opened Indonesia's 2026/2027 Geopark Run Series on the slopes of Mount Ijen on 23 August 2026. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The Ijen Geopark Run is a small mountain race with a big backer. The first edition, on Sunday 23 August 2026, drew 839 runners from across Indonesia to Paltuding on Mount Ijen and opened the tourism ministry's 2026/2027 Geopark Run Series [1]. There were 21 km, 10 km and 5 km routes through the Ijen geopark in cool mountain air [1], and the runners who spoke to reporters called the route beautiful and said they would come back [1]. If you want a scenic, uncrowded highland run that doubles as a trip to Ijen, it is a good first edition to build on.

sections.heading: The First Edition
paragraphs: The race was held on Sunday 23 August 2026 and drew 839 runners from different parts of Indonesia [1]. It was the opening event of the 2026/2027 Geopark Run Series, and the Banyuwangi regent said it was the first time the series had come to Ijen [1].
The Banyuwangi regent, Ipuk Fiestiandani, and a tourism ministry official flagged the runners off from Paltuding on Mount Ijen at 5am [1]. There were three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km [1].

sections.heading: What Runners Said
paragraphs: The routes crossed mountain terrain in the Ijen geopark in cool air [1]. A 26-year-old 10 km runner from Probolinggo, taking part for the first time, said the mountain cold was a sensation of its own, that the route was very interesting and truly beautiful, and that they would take part again [1].
A 24-year-old 5 km runner from Banjarmasin came with their extended family for a holiday in Banyuwangi, and said it is hard to find a running route this beautiful [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a highland race you can combine with a trip to Ijen, yes. The field is small, the setting is the point, and the tourism ministry is behind the series.
Pack for the cold. A 5am start at Paltuding is at altitude, and runners described the mountain chill as something they felt in their bones [1]. Check the route profile before choosing the 21 km.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition, including runners' comments given to the reporter. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Ijen Geopark Run in 2026?
faqs.answer: 839 runners from across Indonesia took part in the first edition on Sunday 23 August 2026, starting at 5am from Paltuding on Mount Ijen, Banyuwangi. It opened the tourism ministry's 2026/2027 Geopark Run Series.

faqs.question: What distances does the Ijen Geopark Run offer?
faqs.answer: Three: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km, on routes through the Ijen geopark from Paltuding. In 2026 the runners crossed mountain terrain in cool air, and the 5 km drew families combining the race with a holiday.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at the Ijen Geopark Run?
faqs.answer: Cold at the start. The race sets off at 5am from Paltuding, high on Mount Ijen, and a 2026 runner described the mountain chill as something that got into their bones. Bring a warm layer for the start.
